spec.prompt: During a total solar eclipse, mirrored medium-wide two-shot: the Lydian from reference image 1 (crested bronze helmet pushed up, braids, short beard, crimson tunic, bronze scale corselet, crimson lion shield) on the left and the Mede from reference image 2 (red felt cap, black curly beard, long-sleeved ochre tunic, iron scale corselet, wicker shield, short sword on his RIGHT thigh) on the right; they stand IN the middle of a red-brown river, the water flowing around their knees; there is no dry ground anywhere near them. They stand a few steps apart, facing each other, exactly symmetrical. Their spears are lowered, points resting in the water, shields hanging at their sides; both have their faces turned up to the dark sky, completely still, in awe. Only the water ripples around their legs and their hair and tunics stir in a faint wind. Readable dusk light of a total eclipse: dim, even twilight, an orange glow low along the horizon, every face and costume still clearly readable. No fog, no smoke. Camera: an almost imperceptible slow push-in, steady. Photoreal live-action cinema, crisp focus, high shutter speed with no motion blur. Reference images are identity, costume and location references only: never show the grey studio, the turnaround layout or the inset panels. No text, no watermark.
spec.notes: Cold-open payoff image; frozen, faces up, mirrored.
